items.name: Crusader Plate
items.description:
A suit of full plate worn by time and battle. Engraved on the inside of the chest piece is the following poem:

When dark whispers seek your ear,
Recall the dawn so bright and clear,
Raise your blade, with purpose shine,
And know the heavens march in line.

items.name: Crusader's Greatsword
items.description: A finely craft blade with many knotches and signs of wear.
